description: This file is a README documentation for the 'accepts' Node.js module, describing its API, installation, and usage examples.

methods.name: accepts(req)
methods.description: Creates an Accepts object for the given request, which provides methods to negotiate content types and other headers.

methods.name: .charset(charsets)
methods.description: Returns the first accepted charset from the provided list.

methods.name: .charsets()
methods.description: Returns a list of charsets accepted by the request.

methods.name: .encodings()
methods.description: Returns a list of encodings accepted by the request.

methods.name: .languages()
methods.description: Returns a list of languages accepted by the request.

methods.name: .type(types)
methods.description: Returns the first accepted type from the list.

methods.name: .types()
methods.description: Returns a list of types accepted by the request.
